before.requirement: Link the archive from the root libcares.la target.
before.reason: The old library target and harness link path are both at the root, but the supplied configuration does not establish that this build produces a static libcares.a archive.

after.requirement: Link the archive from the src/lib libcares.la target at its produced location.
after.reason: The changed root rules delegate the build to subdirectories, and src/lib defines libcares.la. The old harness still names the root archive; the supplied root rules contain no library target that produces it.

source_evidence.quote:
DISTCLEANFILES = include/ares_build.h

DIST_SUBDIRS = include src test docs

SUBDIRS = @BUILD_SUBDIRS@

pkgconfigdir = $(libdir)/pkgconfig
pkgconfig_DATA = libcares.pc

EXTRA_DIST = fuzzcheck.sh CMakeLists.txt Makefile.m32 Makefile.msvc README.md buildconf
arestest_LDADD = libgmock.la $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la $(PTHREAD_LIBS)
aresfuzz_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la
aresfuzzname_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la
dnsdump_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la

claims.reason: The same old command names the root archive on both sides. Its path matches the old target location but misses the changed target location. Static archive production before the change remains unconfirmed.
missing_information: The before version of configure.ac must establish whether ./configure --enable-debug produces libcares.a.
The before version of configure.ac is needed to determine whether ./configure --enable-debug produces libcares.a, and therefore whether the old harness satisfied this obligation before the change.
